scientific_target.state_space: Omega(P) is the set of distinct full fine, regular, star triangulations of the CYTools public-wrapper default point configuration for the fixed lattice polytope P.
scientific_target.raw_measure: At each fixed post-burn-in raw observation index, test the marginal law of temp_tri immediately before CYTools duplicate-hash suppression in the exact public augmented CYTools 1.4.12 process.
scientific_target.full_identity: Canonical full-triangulation identity is the sorted tuple of sorted point-label tuples for every maximal simplex, hashed with SHA-256. Polytope identity is bound separately to canonical lattice-point coordinates.
scientific_target.two_face_identity: Canonical two-face identity is the sorted face-indexed collection of sorted simplex vertex tuples for each 2-face; it is a duplicate diagnostic only and does not define the target state space.
nonclaims: A passing finite validation is operational evidence and is not a proof of exact uniformity at large h11.
The yielded first-seen unique sequence is a separate history-dependent projection and is not assumed measure-preserving.
No conclusion transfers from fast or NTFE comparisons to the Uniform-FRST target.

source_bindings.paper: arXiv:2008.01730v1, Algorithm 3 and Appendix A Eq. A.1

candidate_fixture_selection.source_file: cytools/triangulation.py or cytools/polytope.py from installed CYTools 1.4.12
candidate_fixture_selection.selection_rule: Enumerate candidates in the listed order using the public all_triangulations(only_fine=True, only_regular=True, only_star=True) defaults. Select the first three candidates with a complete support size K in [2,500]. If fewer than three qualify, return CALIBRATION_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT and run no sampler calibration.

support_window.stop_after_count_interpretation: A candidate yielding 501 distinct states is ineligible (>500); do not claim its complete support size.

candidates.source_locator: cytools/polytope.py:2984-2996, all_triangulations example; docs state 7-point configuration and 2 default FRSTs
cytools/triangulation.py:1940-1948, is_equivalent example; docs construct two distinct default all_triangulations results
cytools/triangulation.py:106-113, triangulate example; docs identify the polytope as reflexive and its point configuration as 7 points

sampler_control_grid.rationale: Appendix A of arXiv:2008.01730v1 uses N_walk=50 and N_flip=40 for Algorithm 3.
Preregistered stricter burn-in, walk, flip, and wall fine-tuning control.

calibration_protocol.seed_rule: For fixture order f starting at 1, seed_i=0x11500000+f*0x00100000+i for i=0..N-1. The same fixed seed list is used for both controls to make control comparisons paired. Seeds are frozen after K is enumerated and before any fair-sampler candidate observation is read.
calibration_protocol.seed_type: NumPy legacy global RNG-compatible unsigned 32-bit integer
calibration_protocol.concurrency: At most one active fair chain in each Python process; no thread-concurrent fair chains.
calibration_protocol.public_wrapper: Invoke CYTools Polytope.random_triangulations_fair with points=None, N=None, make_star=True, and every other control explicit. The instrumented function is an AST-only validation wrapper of the exact installed random_triangulations_fair_generator source.
calibration_protocol.early_termination: Advance every started restart until raw index 25 and the fixed k first-discovery unique projection are both observed, or until the public process terminates. Any termination before a required raw index fails RAW_UNIFORM_MARGINAL for that fixture/control. Any termination before k first discoveries fails UNIQUE_STORAGE_PROJECTION. Never replace seeds, omit failures, or condition a marginal on survivor chains. Stop that fixture/control at its first protocol failure and persist the complete attempted-seed evidence; the fixed N-seed schedule remains frozen.
calibration_protocol.full_support_enumeration: CYTools 1.4.12 Polytope.all_triangulations(only_fine=True, only_regular=True, only_star=True, as_list=False) with public default point labels; canonical full-triangulation identity is used to verify support uniqueness.
calibration_protocol.equivalence_controls: For every selected fixture/control, compare a public and instrumented chain in separate spawned processes at the same frozen seed; require exact raw candidate identities, duplicate events, retry counts, termination result, yielded unique identities, and loop counter/state trace equality.
calibration_protocol.reproducibility_and_scheduling: Repeat one frozen seed in separate spawned processes. For the first eight frozen restart task IDs, compare outcomes under worker counts 1 and 4 and reversed task submission order; task identity and outcome must be unchanged.
calibration_protocol.rng_isolation: Run independently seeded fair chains only in spawned worker processes. No Python thread runs a fair chain. The instrumented callback uses no random generator and records the active process ID.
calibration_protocol.atomic_staging_and_resume: Write each completed seed result to the append-only JSONL journal as one canonical JSON line, flush and fsync it, and ignore only a final unterminated line on resume. Resume verifies the exact frozen manifest hash and may rerun only a missing seed from the already frozen list. Duplicate completed seed IDs or a mismatched manifest are hard failures. A partial task is restarted from its original seed and never combined with the prior partial observations.
calibration_protocol.collision_and_interruption_tests: Use temporary output roots to force an existing-result collision and a journal interrupted after a partial final line; verify collision fails without overwrite and resume repairs only the incomplete tail before rerunning the same frozen seed.
calibration_protocol.early_termination_adversarial_test: Under the exact instrumented CYTools source, substitute a deterministic Triangulation stub whose is_fine() always returns true and set the test-only max_retries=1. The public process must terminate before any candidate observation; the gate must fail with zero replacements and no survivor-conditioned statistics.
calibration_protocol.fail_closed_stop_rule: If any identity/source mismatch or early termination occurs, close the affected gate immediately, retain evidence, and do not continue to population or large-h11 claims unless the relevant earlier gates pass.

raw_uniformity.test: Monte-Carlo Pearson multinomial goodness-of-fit against p_i=1/K at each fixed raw index
raw_uniformity.familywise_correction: Holm across every selected fixture x control x raw observation index test
additional_envelopes: two-sided central 99% maximum absolute state-frequency-deviation null envelope

unique_projection.sample_unit: The first k yielded unique full-FRST identities from each fixed restart seed, in first-discovery order.
unique_projection.inclusion_diagnostic: Pearson, total-variation, and maximum absolute inclusion-frequency deviation compared to Monte-Carlo samples of N independent exact uniform k-subsets of K states, generated by the preregistered sequential conditional-binomial construction.
unique_projection.order_diagnostic: For every first-discovery position 1..k, Pearson, total-variation, and maximum absolute state-frequency deviation compared to the exact multinomial marginal for N independent uniform permutations without replacement.
unique_projection.familywise_correction: Holm across the complete inclusion plus first-discovery-position test family
unique_projection.missing_sequence_rule: Any restart that terminates before k yielded unique identities fails the projection gate; do not remove it from the reference comparison.

large_h11_plan.subset_rule: Use the first listed manifest polytope for h11=50, 100, and 200, plus the unique h11=491 entry.
large_h11_plan.controls: Selected exact-support control and 01-stricter, if and only if exact-support raw marginal calibration passes.
large_h11_plan.diagnostics: Rank-normalized split R-hat <= 1.01 for every scalar; aggregate bulk ESS >= 1000 where defined; paired source-control versus stricter-control chain-mean Welch tests with Holm familywise alpha 0.01.
large_h11_plan.claim_boundary: Passing is operational stability evidence only; failure returns UNIFORMITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

appendix_a_benchmark.source: arXiv:2008.01730v1 Appendix A Eq. A.1, lines corresponding to h11=11 and 330019 FRSTs
observables: RMS of nonzero triple intersection numbers where computation is available
appendix_a_benchmark.reference_rule: Compare numeric metrics against full exact/source references only when those values are recoverable from a bounded complete computation or published numeric source data. Otherwise record the paper's qualitative reference and mark numeric reference unavailable; never substitute a comparison-sampler reference.

comparison_plan.glimmers_or_gnn: Not run unless exact current repository capability/policy permits it; current adapter says GNN samplers are unavailable.
comparison_plan.polytope_subset: The same first three exact-support calibration fixtures, if at least three qualify.
comparison_plan.interpretation: Biased comparison ensembles only; report exact denominators and uncertainty, with no transfer of population claims.

open_policy.search_scope: Issue #115 governing history/comments, repository policy and design records
open_policy.fallback_if_absent: OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED_OPEN_POLICY for the open sub-contract only

resource_caps_and_stops.calibration: Do not lower N or any frozen index. Stop the affected fixture/control on first preregistered gate failure and preserve all attempted outcomes. Do not treat unexecuted seeds as observations.
resource_caps_and_stops.large_h11: No large-h11 runs unless all exact-support raw marginal gates pass and the augmented-process equivalence gate passes.
resource_caps_and_stops.appendix_a: Two hours wall time for complete reference reconstruction after the 10000-output sampler run; retain bounded source-only evidence if exact numeric references do not complete within this cap.
resource_caps_and_stops.comparisons: Five minutes per polytope/method, with a maximum of 100 yielded outputs; report shortfall and exact terminal reason.

required_artifacts: frozen validation manifest and SHA-256 receipt
successes, failures, duplicates, retry/counter state, exact denominators
null simulations, statistics, corrected p-values, and envelopes
process isolation, scheduling, staging/interruption, and collision evidence
